name: What permits do I need to build a custom home in Los Angeles County?

mainEntity.name: What permits and approvals are typically required for a custom home in Los Angeles?
mainEntity.text: What permits and approvals are typically required for a custom home in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: Permit requirements in Los Angeles vary by city, neighborhood, lot type, and project scope. A standard custom home often needs architectural plans, structural calculations, and building permits, while hillside or complex sites may also need grading permits, geotechnical reports, and additional approvals for retaining walls or drainage. Lots in certain districts may face design review, planning review, or neighborhood-specific restrictions. This is why early due diligence is critical before finalizing a design or buying a lot. A good builder should help identify likely permitting hurdles early, so the project can be budgeted and scheduled realistically. Homeowners should also confirm who is responsible for submitting plans, tracking corrections, and responding to agency comments.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most custom homes in Los Angeles need plan review, building permits, structural approvals, and often additional approvals for grading, utilities, trees, or hillside work. Depending on the lot, the process can also involve zoning checks, design review, and other local agency requirements.
